about: The secreta of the formulary “Nativity of the Lord — Mass during the Night” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: May the offering of this day’s solemnity be acceptable to You, O Lord, we beseech You, that by the bounty of Your grace, through this most sacred exchange, we may be found in the likeness of Him in whom our nature is with You. Who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God,

a.g: the offering of this day’s solemnity
by the bounty of Your grace
we may be found in His likeness
Who lives and reigns with You

ex.w012: Tua grátia largiénte is an ablative absolute: Your grace does the bestowing. It is not being bestowed. The phrase presents the requested likeness to Christ as a gift of grace.
